Test Description: Verify questionnaire page loads after sign up
Steps to Execute:
1. Complete sign up with valid credentials
2. Wait for redirect
3. Observe the page
Expected Results:
1. User is redirected to https://app.digitalstylist.com/questionnaire
2. "Let's set up your Style Profile" heading is displayed
3. "Question 1 of 5" subtitle is visible
4. Step progress indicator shows step 1 as active
5. Question 1 (Body Type) content loads

Test Description: Verify progress indicator shows 5 steps
Steps to Execute:
1. Navigate to questionnaire page
2. Observe the step progress bar at the top
Expected Results:
1. Progress bar shows 5 numbered circles (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
2. Step 1 is highlighted/active (filled circle)
3. Steps 2-5 are inactive (outlined/grey)
4. Steps are connected by lines

Test Description: Verify progress indicator updates on each step
Steps to Execute:
1. Complete Step 1, click Continue
2. Observe progress indicator on Step 2
3. Continue through all steps, observing each time
Expected Results:
1. Step 1: Circle 1 active, 2-5 inactive
2. Step 2: Circle 1 has green checkmark (✓), Circle 2 active
3. Step 3: Circles 1-2 have checkmarks, Circle 3 active
4. Step 4: Circles 1-3 have checkmarks, Circle 4 active
5. Step 5: Circles 1-4 have checkmarks, Circle 5 active

Test Description: Verify "Skip for now" link is available on all steps

1. Navigate to Step 1

Expected Results:
1. "Skip for now" link is visible on all 5 steps
2. Link is positioned next to the "Let's set up your Style Profile" heading
3. Link is clickable on every step

Test Description: Verify "Skip for now" link skips entire questionnaire

Expected Results:

Test Description: Verify Back button on Step 1

Test Description: Verify Back button navigates to previous step (Steps 2-5)

3. Observe navigation
Expected Results:
1. User is taken back to Step 1
2. Previously selected option on Step 1 is still selected (persisted)
3. Progress indicator reverts to Step 1 active
4. Repeat for Steps 3→2, 4→3, 5→4

Test Description: Verify selections persist when navigating Back and Forward
Steps to Execute:
1. Select "Hourglass" on Step 1, click Continue
2. Select "Shoulders" and "Legs" on Step 2, click Continue
3. Click Back to Step 2
4. Observe selections on Step 2
5. Click Back to Step 1
6. Observe selection on Step 1
Expected Results:
1. Step 2: "Shoulders" and "Legs" are still selected
2. Step 1: "Hourglass" is still selected
3. No data is lost during back/forward navigation

Test Description: Verify complete end-to-end onboarding flow (happy path)
Steps to Execute:
1. Step 1: Select "Hourglass" → Continue
2. Step 2: Select "Waist" and "Legs" → Continue
3. Step 3: Select "Midsection" → Continue
4. Step 4: Select 6 colors (Black, White, Navy Blue, Red, Beige/Cream, Gold) → Continue
5. Step 5: Select 3 styles (Chic, Classic, Minimalist) → Complete Setup
Expected Results:
1. Each step advances correctly
2. Progress indicator updates on each step
3. On Step 5, "Complete Setup" button submits all data
4. User is redirected to Dashboard/Home page
5. Style Profile is saved and reflected in user preferences
Test Data:
Step 1: Hourglass
Step 2: Waist, Legs
Step 3: Midsection
Step 4: Black, White, Navy Blue, Red, Beige/Cream, Gold
Step 5: Chic, Classic, Minimalist
